Directional Overlay

A blue overlay slides in from the left edge on hover/focus, like a directional wipe.

Hover or focus the image to see the effect.

HTML

CSS

.hover-effect.directional-overlay{
  position: relative;
  display: block;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.hover-effect.directional-overlay::before{
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.55);
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hover-effect.directional-overlay:hover::before,
.hover-effect.directional-overlay:focus-visible::before{
  transform: translateX(0);
}

The ::before pseudo-element slides in from the left via transform: translateX(-100%) -> translateX(0) on hover/focus. Select the code and copy with Ctrl+C or ⌘C.
